newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Bedie signs decrees on privatisation of Hotel Mont Khorogo in northern Ivory Coast and agro-industrial group Palmindustrie, cabinet statement says.

- Ruling Democratic Party chief Laurent Dona-Fologo appeals to members not to be afraid to go out and vote in Sunday's partial elections in opposition strongholds around central town of Gagnoa. Legislative polls were postponed there last year because of violence in which ruling party supporters were main targets.
- "Don't succumb to provocation by our adversaries," Opposition party leader Laurent Gbagbo tells supporters in his Gagnoa stronghold in runup to partial elections there.
- "There is no opposition in Ivory Coast, only opponents," declares president of Ivorian Human Rights League Rene Degni Segui in speech at forum for journalists.
- Air Afrique hit hard by West African air controllers' strike; passenger and cargo flights disrupted.
